rationale: The exact decision's provisional NO recommendation is supported within the supplied source perimeter. EO 13925 §§1–8, 85 FR 34079–34083 (PDF pp.1–5). Section 2 directs agency interpretation and an NTIA/FCC petition; §3 requires spending review/report and Justice review; §4 provides complaints and FTC consideration/reporting; §5 establishes a state-law working group, model legislation and information collection; §6 requires a federal legislative proposal. Deadlines alone do not exhaust this entire package. EO 14029 §1, 86 FR 27025 (PDF p.1), explicitly and wholly revokes EO 13925. Section 2 distinguishes rescission of implementing actions and abolition of established entities, qualifying that cleanup by applicable law without qualifying §1's revocation. EO 13925 §8 preserves independent authority/OMB functions and lawful funding constraints. Pending petitions, developed proposals, collected complaints, or independently authorized FTC/state enforcement are consequences or separate powers, not continuing EO 13925 commands. EO 14148 §2(gg) revokes EO 14029; full text, including §3(b)'s future review/replacement directions, does not re-enact EO 13925 or reconstitute its working group.
